Diagnostic_Questions: When hail or wind storms hit your market, how quickly does your team respond to new inbound leads?
Who follows up on unworked storm leads after 6 PM?
What percentage of web form leads go uncalled for more than 15 minutes?
details.Quantification_Question: If a competitor calls a storm lead 10 minutes before you do, what is that lost $15,000 re-roof costing your pipeline?
details.Reflection_Script: So if I understand correctly, the issue isn't lead volume — it's that high-value opportunities slip through when your team is occupied. Is that fair?
details.AI_Fit_Transition: That's exactly why we built the AI Storm Surge Lead Intake & Satellite Inspection Qualifier. It integrates with your current schedule, answers on the 1st ring, qualifies the job specifications, and books the appointment directly.

details.CTA_Fallback: No problem at all Elena Winslow. What's the best email address to send our 1-page operational benchmark report to?

Objection_Playbook.PRICE: I completely understand. Our retainer is $3,000.00/mo with a 30-day performance SLA — recovering just two missed jobs pays for 100% of the cost. If it doesn't, you cancel immediately.
Objection_Playbook.TIMING: Totally respect that you're busy right now. When is a better 5-minute window tomorrow morning to reconnect?
Objection_Playbook.TRUST: Fair point — we don't ask for any trust upfront. We run a 5-minute live diagnostic simulation with your actual test scenarios so you hear it work before deciding.
Objection_Playbook.AI_SKEPTICISM: I hear that a lot because most AI chatbots sound robotic. Ours uses sub-second neural voice trained specifically on your industry's exact terminology and workflow.
Objection_Playbook.ALREADY_HAVE_SOLUTION: That's great you have a system in place. Most operators we work with use this as a 24/7 backup overflow failover so zero calls drop when your team is occupied.
Objection_Playbook.DO_IT_INTERNALLY: Your team's time is best spent closing deals and serving clients, not playing phone tag. The AI handles the repetitive triage at a fraction of human staffing cost.
Objection_Playbook.NO_NEED: Understood. If you ever experience missed calls during peak season, keep us in mind.
Objection_Playbook.NO_BUDGET: If budget is tight, that's even more reason to stop leaking high-value leads. We can start with our diagnostic audit at zero upfront commitment.
Objection_Playbook.AUTHORITY: Got it. Who on your management team handles operational technology and intake software so I can include them?
Objection_Playbook.SECURITY: All our pipelines are SOC-2 and HIPAA compliant with end-to-end encryption. Your client data never trains public models.
Objection_Playbook.INTEGRATION: We connect directly via webhooks to your existing CRM and calendar (ServiceTitan, Clio, Dentrix, Procore, HubSpot) with zero migration hassle.
Objection_Playbook.STAFF: This doesn't replace your staff — it empowers them by handling repetitive triage and 2 AM emergencies so they arrive to work with organized, booked appointments.
